messages:
nina: heads up, deploybot flagged release/3.6.0: push failed due to tag collision in eu-central ECR.
deploybot: publish blocked: tag_collision_detected. existing_tag_digest=sha256:ffee... new_push_digest=sha256:ffee... (same digest) but existing tag owned by different pipeline id 2105
nina: same digest but different pipeline id? means a mirror/replication wrote the tag earlier.
ci-bot: checking build metadata: pipeline id 2211 produced digest sha256:ffee... at 1743003300; gcr->ecr replication job 2105 rehydrated that digest to eu region at 1743003290.
ayush: weird race: our replication lambda ran slightly earlier than our canonical push and claimed the tag. deploybot refuses to overwrite tags by default.
ops-bot: policy: tags are immutable unless `override_tag_collision=true` set in deploybot config and 2 approvers are present.
nina: quick fix: retag with new ephemeral release tag `release/3.6.0-republish-rlz` and publish. then schedule a canonical tag move during maintenance.
deploybot: note: if we retag, the manifestlist digest will change; consumers pinned to digest unaffected.
ayush: retagging ok for staging. for prod we must coordinate with partners consuming our public ECR mirror. schedule a tag-handoff doc.
ci-bot: retag performed: `docker tag <digest> registry/eu/release:3.6.0-republish-rlz` and push done. deploybot published to staging.
nina: canary looks good. add to release notes: "republish under ephemeral tag due to cross-pipeline tag collision; original digest unchanged"
ayush: follow-up: adjust replication job to avoid claiming tags for digests without pipeline metadata header, and add an exponential backoff to reduce races.
ops-bot: created ticket INFRA-4821 for replication job fix and tag-handoff runbook.
nina: we'll schedule a non-disruptive tag handoff during low traffic window to unify tags.
ci-bot: closing thread: monitoring for 1h then close.
